name: Waukesha County, WI
findings: Waukesha County has 1,544 nonprofit organizations. 686 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 559 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Waukesha County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Foundation organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 17 foundation organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do foundation organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Waukesha County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Few research and think tank organizations list membership
observations.text: 7 research and think tank organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 15 would.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through research and think tank groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 108 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 108 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
